content.text: The loader now resolves the config before the worker starts, so a malformed row lands in the dead letter table within one attempt instead of retrying forever. I ran the suite twice and read the pass line both times. The second run used a cold cache so the result is not a replay of the first. One caller in the billing path still passes the old shape, and I have left that alone because changing it would widen this past what you asked for. Nothing else in the tree reads it.
